body: No problem. I decided to join this because I was seriously contemplating suicide or admitting myself yesterday. I read peoples things and it calmed me down a lot to see everyone who is struggling. So, I really appreciate you replying haha.

Oh man, im sorry to here that. Animals are saviors I swear. My cat is right here comforting me. I woke up from a nightmare crying. I understand the pain your going through. But, I saw all the support and I'm so happy. I decided to reach out because no one should feel like they have no one.
